units.source_text: 采茶时节刚开始的时候，阿住的儿子去世了。

en.t: At the very beginning of the tea-picking season, Azumi's son died.

units.source_text: 儿子仁太郎跟瘫痪了差不多，已经因病卧床八年有余。

en.t: Her son Jintaro was almost paralyzed, and had been bedridden with illness for more than eight years.

units.source_text: 这样一个儿子的离去，对于被称作“来世积德”的阿住而言，她心中不仅仅有哀伤。

en.t: For Azumi, who was said to be earning merit for the next life, the loss of such a son brought more than grief.

units.source_text: 当她手里举着一炷香，在儿子的棺材前面的时候，心中还有一种放下负担的解脱感。

en.t: As she held a stick of incense in her hand before her son's coffin, she also felt the relief of having laid down a burden.
